## Citation

To cite this package in publications, please use:

Betebenner D, Van Iwaarden A (2026). _SGPstateData: State Assessment Program Meta-Data for the SGP
Package_. Center for Assessment. Meta-data repository; the built object ships in the SGP package,
<https://github.com/CenterForAssessment/SGPstateData>.

A BibTeX entry:

```bibtex
@Manual{,
  title = {SGPstateData: State Assessment Program Meta-Data for the SGP Package},
  author = {Damian W. Betebenner and Adam R. {Van Iwaarden}},
  organization = {Center for Assessment},
  year = {2026},
  url = {https://github.com/CenterForAssessment/SGPstateData},
  note = {Meta-data repository; the built object ships in the SGP package},
}
```
